insurance_intermediary_role.label: Insurance intermediary role
insurance_intermediary_role.value: Managing general agent / program manager: Hagerty determines final risk acceptance while policies are underwritten by partner carriers; also places partner-provided coverages.

insurance_placement_niche.label: Insurance placement niche
insurance_placement_niche.value: Specialty personal lines for classic and collector vehicles, plus event, track day, marine business and personal umbrella coverage.

intermediary_compensation.label: Intermediary compensation
intermediary_compensation.value: Commissions and fees from carriers on policies placed; also membership and marketplace revenue. Commission detail not given on the site.

carrier_market_access.label: Carrier / market access
carrier_market_access.value: Access to a small set of carrier partners, with policies underwritten by Markel and Travelers, plus other trusted partners for extra coverages.

notes: Compensation and role are partly from prior knowledge of Hagerty's MGA model; the site gives no retention figures.
